description: Decouples the scaling of individual GUIs, the HUD, and Tooltips.

releases.notes:
1.12.2-1.0.3.1
* Bug Fix - Fixes ConcurrentModificationException (#1). Thanks to Srdjan-V.

1.12.2-1.0.3.0
* Added dynamic scaling for whitelisted GuiContainers
* Bug Fix - Button click no longer playing twice on Gui Scales when Optifine is installed

You are free to use it in any modpack without prior permission.

1.12.2-1.0.2.1
* Bug Fix - Video Settings now scales correctly after changing the main GUI scale settings

1.12.2-1.0.2.0
* Added compatibility with Optifine

1.12.2-1.0.1.0
* Added delete function to custom entry screens

1.12.2-1.0.0.1
* Select-value screens now return to parent screen on ESC press

1.12.2-1.0.0.0:
* Separate scale settings for GUIs, the HUD, and Tooltips
* Custom scales for specific GUIs
* Greater range of scales (1-8) than in vanilla Minecraft (1-3)
* Scale settings presented as sliders
* Config options to log GUI class names to easily add new custom scale settings while in-game
